scope: source-background-selected optimization; all old target-query results are exploratory because v1 queries were already inspected
selection_metric: mean balanced accuracy of main and half-amplitude source-validation queries, paired background roles
notes: No old models are used for source cross-validation: each fold is trained from scratch on allowed source backgrounds.
Weak source augmentation uses only labelled source pairs and unmodified source controls; no target-query controls are used for fitting.
The optimized transfer assumes identical known class meanings in source and target; not a novel-class method.
Extra stress variants share the same 22 target backgrounds; they are new generated responses, not new independent devices or failures.
V1 data, results, code and delivery archives are retained unchanged.
